title: Combining Special-Order Deposit Reductions by Harbison Products Held (Repair and Emergency Service Calls)
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, how a customer's deposit reductions come off the special-order deposit rate depends on how many Harbison products the customer holds. Four holdings are counted:

- an active agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements;
- a closed installation under Replacement System Installations;
- an active contract under Harbison Protection Contracts;
- an active subscription under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions.

**Rule.**

| Harbison products held | Deposit reductions taken off the rate |
|---|---|
| 3 or 4 | Both reductions |
| Exactly 2 | Only the larger reduction |
| 1 or none | No reduction |

The points so taken off reduce the deposit rate before it is applied, and the rate never falls below zero.

## Worked examples (hypothetical customers, 50 percent rate, reductions of 10 and 5 points earned)

| Products held | Points taken off | Rate applied |
|---|---|---|
| Agreement, installation, protection contract | 10 and 5, which is 15 | 35 percent |
| Agreement and installation | 10 (the larger) | 40 percent |
| Installation only | None | 50 percent |
